reviews.text:
My two Chihuahuas are 1 year and 9 months old. One is terrified of walks and freezes up, unable to walk, while the other crawls on the ground as if trying to escape. I tried various things on my own, but nothing worked.

At my wit's end, I was drawn to the phrase "specializing in fearful dogs" and made an appointment for a consultation.

When I entered the classroom with my Chihuahuas, I was immediately surprised. There were 10 dogs, each in a crate, but not a single one barked. The instructor said, "They're taking a nap." Even while I was having my consultation and talking right next to them, they didn't bark. That day, they let one of the dogs out of the classroom, and my Chihuahuas were able to greet it by sniffing its rear end!

I was so impressed by the instructor's guidance that I decided to enroll them in the kindergarten.

At kindergarten, the goals were walks and teeth brushing.

Thanks to the instructors' loving guidance, they achieved almost all of their goals in 7 sessions and graduated.

They provide videos every time, so we can see a record of our dog's growth, and we can also consult with the teachers via LINE, which is very reassuring.

The teachers teach with enthusiasm and love, and provide careful instruction. When I dropped off my dog ​​in the morning, I was touched to see them holding him tightly and waving with a smile. Thank you, teachers!

I'm so glad we went to the kindergarten!!

I highly recommend going for a consultation!

We initially requested in-home training for our 1-year-3-month-old Maltipoo (female) after moving.

At our previous home, she wasn't having trouble with potty training outside her cage, and we also wanted to improve her barking at the doorbell, which is a sensitive age for her.

Besides potty training and barking, they helped us with all sorts of issues, including walks, staying and mat training, and her habit of biting our neighbors' feet. They listened carefully to our concerns each time, and for walk guidance, they came early in the morning to teach us. Thanks to their efforts, potty training was a success, and now she goes to the tray on her own when asked "Do you need to pee?"

Six months later, most of our problems are gone!

It wasn't cheap, but considering the long-term benefits, I'm so glad we didn't give up and hired a professional. I wholeheartedly recommend them to anyone struggling with their dog's needs.

We had our rescued Chihuahua boy (3 years old) receive lessons at the kindergarten. He would bite hard when we put on his harness or wipe his paws after walks, making it impossible to do necessary care like brushing and teeth cleaning, and we were at our wits' end. I was afraid they would refuse to take an adult dog that bites, so I didn't have the courage to inquire for months, but I decided to start with the inquiry form. They listened to my story carefully, and when I went for a consultation, they said it would be perfectly fine, which was incredibly reassuring. With each visit, I could see him grow, and he was able to do everything he couldn't do before. The instructor is very trustworthy. The pick-up and drop-off service was also a great help. If you have a problem and are wondering whether to seek advice, I would definitely recommend them.

I requested in-home training because my dog ​​was having trouble barking.

From the initial phone call, they provided a thorough consultation.

They visited my home and carefully explained how to deal with the problem.

If I had any questions along the way, they kindly answered them via LINE.

With each visit, the barking decreased, and I was starting to think we could end the visits soon. I was hesitant to ask if it was okay for me to say so, but the trainer suggested that since things were improving, we could just continue the training until today and see how things go.

Honestly, I was surprised.

I never expected the trainer to say that, so I was incredibly grateful.

I'm so glad I chose this company because they have such a conscientious and trustworthy trainer!

Thank you very much!

I had the opportunity to have someone come to my home and teach me various things. They explained everything clearly, and I learned a great deal.

I've been putting what the instructor taught me into practice, and my dog ​​has become much calmer. Thank you so much!

I plan to ask the instructor for advice on training again in the future.

My 10-year-old rescue dog (male) is extremely timid and can't even go for walks. He's sensitive to noises and barks a lot.

I had a lesson at my home.

You paid very close attention to my dog's behavior,

and your instruction was very clear and accurate.

I immediately saw positive changes.

He's now able to go for walks every day, which makes me very happy.

I actually had lessons elsewhere before smart-dog, but we still couldn't take him for walks.

He's still extremely timid, but you taught me what to do in certain situations, so I was able to deal with the situation calmly and feel more at ease.

Thank you so much.

I'll continue to love him and hope to live a happy life with him, and I'd appreciate your guidance whenever I have a problem.

He used to be a bit of a timid dog, but thanks to the kind teachers and friends, he has become a calmer dog. He seems to have gained confidence through various lessons. When I pick him up from kindergarten, he tells me how his day went, and I also like that he lets me take lessons.

I was really worried about my dog's excessive barking during walks. He had attended training courses at other daycare centers since he was a puppy, but there was no improvement. So I went to Smart-Dog, a specialist in fearful dogs, for a consultation.

They listened attentively to my concerns and, above all, understood my desire to reduce his barking and make walks enjoyable for him. I was truly grateful for that.

I requested home training, and there was significant improvement after the first session.

We will continue to work hard on training together so that my dog ​​can enjoy walks without fear. Thank you very much.

I was worried about my 1-year-10-month-old dachshund barking during walks and getting overly excited when we were out, so I called to inquire. They listened attentively to my concerns, and I decided to entrust my dog ​​to their care.
It was my first time, but they sent me videos of the classroom, and when I picked up my dog, they practiced walking lessons with me and explained everything in detail, which was very helpful. My dog ​​seemed to enjoy each visit, learning obedience and play from the trainer.
I'm so glad I chose them. I'm truly grateful for the days they treated my dog ​​not just as a dog, but as a member of the family. Please continue to train any new family members with the same passion and dedication as you did with our Leon. Thank you so much for everything.

We recently welcomed an 8-month-old toy poodle into our home. We suspected he had separation anxiety, and we were overwhelmed with worries and anxieties about his excitability, toileting, and walks, so it was starting to feel like we were losing it. That's when we searched for a solution and found smart-dog. We asked them to provide in-home training, and we were able to discuss any concerns we had not only during the visit but also via LINE, receiving appropriate advice and encouragement each time. Thanks to them, we were able to see improvements and solutions after four visits, and we're really pleased and glad we asked them to help us. Both our dog and we loved the kind trainers!
If we have the opportunity, we'd like to use their kindergarten as well.
Thank you so much!

I recently had my Shiba Inu, who is almost two years old, taken in for training. He's incredibly timid, so he's terrified of the outdoors, pulling hard on the leash during walks and backing away when scared...
He seemed to be suffering, so we could only walk for 5-10 minutes in the morning and evening. Feeling terrible about this, I contacted the training center, and they came to my home so we could train him in his usual environment.
They observed him during walks outside and gave me several specific tasks to work on!
I thought it might take a while to complete the tasks because he's such a scaredy-cat, but
surprisingly, I'm already seeing positive changes...
What I learned from this experience is that it's not just the dog that needs training, but the owner as well.
My awareness of working hard together with my dog ​​has increased, and even walks, which I used to dread, are becoming a little more positive.
The trainer was very kind.

I used your services with my 12-year-old and 7-year-old toy poodles. (^^)
I consulted with you about how to deal with my elderly dog, who had become unfamiliar with the toilet due to a change in environment after moving, and my dog, who was naturally sensitive to noise and barked a lot.
You came to our home and taught us how to incorporate training into our daily lives, so we saw immediate results from the first day of training. ♪
When I inquired with another company, they said they could only treat babies, but they were able to accept my 12-year-old grandmother, which was very helpful. (^^)
By teaching me the appropriate treatment methods, my dogs were able to get a sense of their future, and I wish I had treated them sooner.
I'll definitely consult with you again if I have any new problems. ♪
Thank you so much. (^^)

The representative is a very kind person!
They kindly listened to my concerns even though my dog ​​is 11 years old.
My dog ​​was originally adopted as a rescue dog when he was one year old and experienced separation anxiety at that age. I was worried that it might be recurring, so I searched online and found smart-dog.
I had the impression that dog training classes and kindergartens were expensive, but when I inquired, they were very kind and understanding, and the fees didn't seem expensive at all. They were so kind, thorough, and caring that I wondered if they really deserved it!
They conducted a thorough consultation, observing my dog's behavior and analyzing it carefully. They clarified that it wasn't separation anxiety, but rather something that had triggered his demanding behavior. Following their guidance, the problem improved very quickly.

Being able to contact them via LINE at any time was very reassuring.

Thank you so much!!
I will definitely contact you again if I need anything else.

I first used their in-home training service four months ago. I had given up on the idea of ​​taking lessons because my home is far away, but I decided to inquire anyway, and they were very kind and agreed to teach my dog! They understood my dog's timid nature very well, and he has improved remarkably with each lesson! Since most of the problems we had at home have been resolved, we decided to try lessons at the dojo. The teachers at the dojo are also very kind and teach my dog ​​at his own pace, and they give us a very thorough review after each lesson. They also answer any questions or concerns we have via LINE very carefully, and I am so grateful for their attentive support! If you have a timid dog, I highly recommend it! You can also see pictures of the dojo, teachers, and dogs on Instagram, so if you're interested, I recommend checking it out ^_^

They treat each dog with love and care, and my dog ​​gets incredibly excited just by hearing the name "teacher."

They also provide thorough training, and my dog ​​learns something new each time, making it so much fun to review what we learned when we get home!

Our rescue dog was a stray at one month old and became part of our family at three months. She's extremely timid and wary. She's afraid of the outside and won't leave the front door; she gets scared when we take her to the vet and poops and pees when we try to pick her up. She's adorable, but we were at our wits' end.

Attracted by the "specializing in timid dogs" service, we requested in-home training.

They taught us how to gradually get our dog outside, adapting to our dog's needs, including how to handle her backing away. Now she loves being outside and walks with her tail wagging! They not only help with walks but also offer advice on other problems we're facing. We're so grateful for how they've helped bring out our dog's potential.

Most importantly, our dogs absolutely adore the trainer; it's heartwarming to see them excited and restless long before she arrives for training sessions.

The trainer came to my home and trained for several months. I was really worried about my dog's barking when the doorbell rang, barking at visitors, and biting, but he gave me specific solutions to address my problems and taught me how to train him at home, and he has made a big improvement! The trainer was kind and good at giving praise, which made me feel at ease as a pet owner, so I'm glad I asked him to help me.
The trainers are very kind, and our dogs enjoy going there.
